entities.name: Dairy B. cereus Hbl clade association
observations: In a whole-genome study of 22 dairy-origin Bacillus cereus-group isolates with 47 reference genomes, Hbl lateral-flow detection differed by clade: clade IV consistently produced Hbl and was significantly more likely to produce it (p=0.0001), while clade III-c lacked hblACD and Hbl production.
Clade was not deterministic: only 13 of 18 hblACD-positive isolates had detectable Hbl, and clade VI carried hbl homologues without detectable production.

entities.name: Dairy Hbl genotype phenotype discordance
observations: A follow-up study of 44 dairy-associated isolates and eight type strains found broad toxin-gene distribution and genotype-phenotype discordance; available abstract does not establish a clade-specific Hbl production association.
